verdict.rationale: Jan is essentially a chat/assistant interface with local & cloud model access, custom assistants, MCP integration, and autonomous agent tasks (files, commands, web research) that could surface insights from data, but there's no dedicated feature for analyzing user's own data (e.g. documents, databases) to proactively generate insights/suggestions — it's more general chat-based Q&A than data-driven insight generation. missing for 10: dedicated data-analysis/insight-generation workflow, evidence of proactive suggestions from user data, independent hands-on validation of this specific capability.
